newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall further on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall further on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further on Thursday at the daily auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.58 and 3.84 percent, respectively, down from 0.65 and 4.08 percent at Wednesday's auctions and from Tuesday's 0.72 and 4.33 percent.
Bids were received for a total of 84.643 billion lev worth of T-bills as the two issues were oversubscribed but the ministry approved bids only for the total par on offer.
The issues were offered with par values of eight billion levs and 35 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 35,000 million levs
Bids received 16,510.1 million levs 68,133.2 million levs
Avg price of bids 99.40 pct 96.25 pct
Bids approved 8,000 million levs 35,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 0.58 pct 3.84 pct
